newsitem.title: USA: AT&T spins off Lucent to shareholders.
newsitem.headline: AT&T spins off Lucent to shareholders.

text.p: AT&T Corp. said Monday it began distributing to shareholders its 525 million shares of common stock in Lucent Technologies as it finalises the spin-off of the telecommunications equipment maker.

The distribution and spin-off, which is part of AT&T's plan to restructure itself into three separate businesses, will result in AT&T shareholders receiving aboiut 82.4 percent of the outstanding shares of Lucent Technologies' common stock.
Lucent Technologies went public with an initial public offering of its stock in April.

As previously announced, the distribution is on the basis of 0.324084 of a share of Lucent for each AT&T share outstanding. In July, the AT&T board declared the special stock dividend to AT&T shareholders of record on Sept. 17.

AT&T also said that after Monday's market close, the New York Stock Exchange expects to end trading of AT&T shares "without distribution," as has occurred over the past two weeks in addition to AT&T's regular shares trading under the symbol T.N. The two forms of trading have represented the value of AT&T either including or excluding Lucent Technologies.
On Oct. 1, AT&T shares will no longer include Lucent's value.
Lucent's stock traded at $44.375, up 75 cents, and AT&T gained 37.5 cents to $51.875, both on the New York Stock Exchange.
